cases.statement: acme/portal 2.4 before 2.4.5 is affected by CVE-2024-0003

expect.note: P2 - reconciled factor set: ARCH-001 s3 annotates this row 'P2 (medium+kev+context)'. The canonical_product_range match over acme/portal 2.4.4 is high confidence (the I1b matcher emits only exact_identifier/canonical_product_range, ADR-015, both high), so the declared factors are high + KEV with a normal/internal context (no P1 context predicate): high and KEV -> P2 (ch. 9.3, confirmed by the task record). The medium-confidence branch is unreachable through the I1b matcher and is pinned by the domain matrix instead (priority_rules_test.go).
P3: exact_identifier on the seeded acme/api 1.0, high confidence, and no strong urgency indicator (no KEV, CVSS 7.2 < 9.0, EPSS 0.60 < 0.95) -> P3 (ch. 9.3).

cases.summary: Information disclosure in the acme/api legacy line

expect.note: P4 (informational, no signal) - reconciled product row: the affected acme/api 0.9 line is not deployed (the seeded component is 1.0), so the run finds no confirmed assignment and no match. Ch. 9.3 classifies 'no confirmed inventory assignment' as P4 (none confidence; candidate/no_match never claim confirmed impact). ARCH-001 s3 lists this row as 'acme/api 1.0'; that deployed version would match and produce a P3 signal, contradicting the annotated P4 - the affected version was therefore set out of range to keep the case informational, matching the domain matrix row 'P4 none no_match informational (C5)' in priority_rules_test.go.

Unmatched case: acme/ghost has no seeded component, so there is no candidate and no match/signal. The asset context is deliberately 'unknown' (a valid, never-upgrading context - ch. 9.3) because the case exists to prove the unmatched path, not a context rule. Ch. 9.3 class: no confirmed assignment -> P4 informational; the optional informational row is not created in I1b.

Malformed case (missing cve_id, ARCH-001 s3 E1): counted as a run error (concept ch. 8.1 step 5) and recorded on the run row; it does not abort the other cases. The run's terminal status is failed when this error is counted.
